status: TEMPLATE — no claim in this file is pinned yet
why: A digest-pinned image says which manifest was pulled. It does not say which BYTES ran: the recipe bind-mounts patched engine files over the image's own, and the capacity profile installs a pinned b12x build on top of the baked one. The build stamp and the engine-critical file hashes say that. This manifest ships UNFILLED on purpose: the hashes cannot be computed without an image, and an invented digest is worse than no digest. Fill it in with make-engine-identity.py (one command, against a container that is already up) and the boot gate becomes a real adoption gate: a re-pinned image fails it until it is re-audited.
how_to_fill: python3 launch/tp3-kit/make-engine-identity.py --profile speed --container ds4flash-tp3-head --write   (run on the box that owns the container, then re-stage the kit)
not_pinned_marker: any value that is not a 64-character lowercase sha256 digest is treated as NOT PINNED: the gate reports it and passes, so a fresh clone boots

speed.note: the karmic-lineage speed image. Its published vllm version string is 0.1.dev21553+gab86b7073 (see the README stack table); make-engine-identity.py records what your container actually reports.
